messages:
Ravi: Quick follow-up from the ingest billing handoff discussion. We still need a dependable fallback when lookups spike or key service rotates. Shareable proposal: small probabilistic prefilter + ingest token-bucket + lightweight patch stream.
Nina: +1. Prefilter reduces backend pressure, token-bucket keeps bursts bounded. We should add explicit meta to trace envelopes so downstream knows 'why' a key is missing.
Theo: Proposal for envelope.meta fields: billing_status ∈ ["final","provisional","deferred","unattributed"]; lookup_strategy ∈ ["direct","prefilter","deferred"]; filter_gen_ts and key_version strings. Keep names short to limit event size.
Ravi: Operational behavior: if prefilter says 'no', sidecar skips lookup and mark provisional or deferred depending on bucket tokens. Ingesters enforce token-bucket per project; when exhausted they mark 'lookup_deferred' and emit metric lookup_deferred_count.
Nina: For corrections, publish billing_patch with {trace_id,billing_key,timestamp,filter_gen_ts,source}. Stitcher backfills within window W (default 30s). Outside W, send to manual correction queue.
Theo: Add circuit-breaker: if cache error rate > threshold for 30s, flip region into 'degraded' mode where all lookups are deferred until recovery. Emit alert and dashboard annotation.
ops-bot: alert: cache-degraded region=us-west1 rate=7.2% window=35s
Ravi: Metrics to add: prefilter_false_positive_rate, prefilter_size_bytes, sidecar_lru_hit_rate, lookup_token_consumption, deferred_ratio, patch_apply_latency. Also small perf guard to limit envelope.meta additions.
Nina: Tasks: Nina -> schema PR adding lookup_strategy, filter_gen_ts, key_version, billing_status enum. Theo -> prefilter proto and sidecar LRU. Ravi -> ingest token-bucket and circuit-breaker. Ops -> dashboard panels for deferred_ratio and patch backlog.
Theo: We'll include a micro e2e that simulates rotational key changes + burst traffic to validate metrics.
Ravi: Decision: adopt prefilter + client cache + ingest rate-limits + billing_patch stream + circuit-breaker. Keep default W=30s and short meta fields. Closing thread after PRs land.
